decisionSummary: Block this immutable 001 package for one P1 incomplete ancestry-exclusion input. Independent replay of stored proof deal seeds found 141 previously consumed later-round families missing from excludedFamilyIds. The fixed 192 initial families are mechanically valid and distinct; all other reviewed source, role, count, resource and process-cleanup boundaries passed the checks listed below. No additional confirmed P1/P2 found within the requested scope.

findings.title: The locked exclusion set omits 141 previously consumed speed/proof later-round families
reproduction: Read only the 16 stored case-NNN-original.json files from the completed inference-proof-results-001 evidence.
For every result.deals entry, initialize the original frozen engine with dealSeed and construct its pre-exchange raw hands; no action, NN or complete match is run.
Compute the existing canonical engineDealFamily of those raw hands and compare membership with the exact 001 excludedFamilyIds.

157 distinct prior round families are reconstructed. The 16 first-round families are present; 141 later-round families are absent. Example: case001/game2/seed2052688012 yields first-deal-family:c09aa08770db979fbd4fb2c1ac81cba0ad39c77b544313629a861ef02b0a5b97 and is absent.
findings.impact: The worker audit correctly reconstructs each future round family, but tests only this incomplete fixed set. Consequently a later variance deal equal to an omitted previously consumed family would pass the declared source/speed ancestry exclusion. The package therefore lacks its claimed exclusion precondition before execution. This does not demonstrate actual contamination of the 192 proposed first deals or an already executed variance result; the proposed pilot remains unexecuted.
findings.recommendation: Create a new immutable input/request/snapshot/contract revision with the full required exclusion closure from all preserved historical raw deal ancestry, including all speed/proof later rounds and the relevant completed C2 baseline ancestry. Keep all 192 predeclared sources/seeds and scientific settings fixed with no replacement, verify no collisions, and obtain current dual reviews. Preserve 001 unchanged and prohibited from execution.

independentChecks.area: Four-seat roles and fixed scientific count
details: Per base: three development partners times U0/probe times two physical sides equals 12 cooperation matches. Both actor and partner occupy the intended same team; both opponents are old O.

M1 adds U0/U0 versus O/O for the two physical side assignments. M2 adds U0+original legacy heuristic1 versus O+the same legacy heuristic1, retaining legacy-per-game RNG. M1/M2 use their separate indexed source streams.

Exactly 16 unique layout IDs per block, 64 fixed blocks and therefore 1024 required physical complete matches. The 12 correlated cooperation observations remain one paired vector per partner per base; the primary is the average of those three group differences.

independentChecks.area: Full ancestry reconstruction and model-information boundary
independentChecks.status: pass with input closure finding above
details: At the first decision of every round, the callback reconstructs original pre-exchange hands by reversing public returns and tributes, validates ownership, four counts of 27 and 108 unique physical IDs, then hashes the canonical family. It requires moveNo zero.

The metadata reconstruction copies hand arrays and does not mutate the game state. A two-tribute/two-return synthetic state recovers the original family. Nonzero moveNo, a missing transferred card, incorrect exchange owner and duplicate card identity all reject.

The callback only writes family metadata and rejects excluded sources; these full hidden hands and future-round hashes do not enter the frozen encoder or NN inputs. No future deal is materialized for policy input. Prior indexed-deal and own/public encoding source is unchanged.

The first family must equal the locked source family; all later families are tested against the locked exclusion set. This mechanism is correct, but the set is incomplete as independently demonstrated in E01.

independentChecks.area: All outcomes complete and typed; no incomplete-as-loss or selected N
details: Each runCompleteMatch return is recorded and any incomplete physical match throws, causing whole-pool failure and no final variance report. The frozen engine returns winner and final target null on incompletion.

pairedVarianceBlock requires 16 unique rows, complete===true, winner and actor strictly in numeric 0/1, finite nonnegative active seconds, exactly two side swaps in each stratum and actor===side. Nineteen independent malformed outcome/layout cases reject.

The parent requires pool.complete and exactly64 results before report creation. Fixed task IDs/ordinals, exclusive block writes and the pool task-ID check bind outputs. Final sample SD uses N-1; design SD uses max(.5,sampleSD), bounded sensitivity remains1, finalNPrimary remainsnull.

Per-match g, W, trace and indexed deals are retained within raw results, but the variance estimand uses the declared complete-match team win. No runtime candidate pass, model update or formal-N selection is performed.

independentChecks.area: Actual parent, lease, budget and exact contract authority
details: The actual frozen parent recognizes variance with fixed canonical task C3-variance-pilot-execution-001, official receipt, output path, ordinal1 and four workers; mutation probes reject alternate ordinal/workers/output/repo/ledger/task/receipt/reservation.

The guard pins the original workspace/cycle and genesis. Original ledger chain, exact3000 reservation, active canonical lease, current parentPID and actual frozen entry are checked. Worker threads reuse the official launch identity and common monotonic origin.

Actual parent authorization requires two different current report bodies with engineering/method roles, unique reviewId/path, exact request SHA and APPROVE_PILOT_EXECUTION; execution-authority accepts only the one exact contract in this request. Source copies and actual snapshot modules must match before launch.

Soft600, pool deadline570 after the fixed30 completion reserve, hard660, max4 workers and conservative4*whole-device-wall charge are fixed. 4*660+120=2760 is within3000. Startup and parent/statistics wall are included in the original budget charge. No reservation or lease was created by this review.

Exclusive official receipt, final result guard, active lease and original settled-task tombstone prevent restarting this once-only ordinal. All guard paths still use the canonical original ledger rather than a caller-selected shadow ledger.

The actual pool deadline starts before workers become ready, dispatch waits for all four, and there is no next-window scheduler. Worker errors, unexpected exits, wrong task IDs and callback/write failures abort, terminate all workers and await exit.

An independent synthetic four-worker run completed all64 fixed tasks without policy calls. Five independent faults (missing ready, startup exception, bad task ID, callback exception, stuck dispatched task) all rejected and left zero MessagePort resources.

Block and final outputs use exclusive writes. A partial run can retain completed raw blocks/opened evidence but cannot emit completed variance or chosen N. Child failure still returns to parent settlement/lease cleanup; no success-by-fallback or default loss path was found.

The child environment remains a fixed allowlist with copied esbuild and tsx paths; injected NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_PATH and PYTHONPATH are absent. No active-source import or preloader authority was introduced.

harnessCorrections.snapshotInventoryFirstAttempt: An auxiliary sourcePath comparison encountered generated files with sourcePath=null. The corrected comparison filters only original-path comparisons; full snapshot verification still covers every generated file and all 173 files. This was a reviewer inventory script issue.
harnessCorrections.poolProbeFirstAttempt: A synthetic fault probe initially used a 250ms deadline for post-ready faults. The real pool correctly refuses dispatch when less than its fixed 1000ms dispatch reserve remains, so the harness observed complete:false instead of the expected bad-task exception. The corrected probe uses 1500ms for dispatched cases and retains 250ms for no-ready/startup-error. The final six cases all passed with no remaining MessagePorts. No product code was changed.
